content: स्थित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [स्था-क्त] .²1 Stood, remained, stayed. .²2 Standing. .²3 Standing up, risen; स्थितः स्थितामुच्चलितः प्रयातां … छायेव तां भूपतिरन्वगच्छत् <ls>R. 2. 6</ls>. .²4 Staying, resting, living, being, existing, situated; धन्या केयं स्थिता ते शिरसि <ls>Mu. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Me. 7</ls>; oft, with gerunds merely as a copula; वेदान्तेषु यमाहुरेकपुरुषं व्याप्य स्थितं रोदसी <ls>V. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 1</ls>. .²5 Happened, occurred; सुहृदः पश्य वसन्त किं स्थितम् <ls>Ku. 4. 27</ls>. .²6 Stationed in, occupying, appointed to; अभिजनवतो भर्तुः श्लाघ्ये स्थिता गृहिणीपदे <ls>Ś. 4. 18</ls>. .²7 Acting up to, abiding by, conforming to; किमत्र चित्रं यदि कामसूर्भूर्वृत्ते स्थितस्याधिपतेः प्रजानाम् <ls>R. 5. 33</ls>; धर्मे स्थिताः (राजानः) <ls>Māl. 10. 25</ls>. .²8 Stood still, stopped, desisted. .²9 Fixed on, firmly attached to; ममात्र भावैकरसं मनः स्थितम् <ls>Ku. 5. 82</ls>. .²10 Steady, firm; as in स्थितधी or स्थितप्रज्ञ <ab>q. v.</ab> .²11 Determined, resolved; इति देहविमुक्तये स्थिताम् (रतिम्) <ls>Ku. 4. 39</ls>. .²12 Established, decreed. .²13 Steadfast in conduct, steady-minded. .²14 Upright, virtuous. .²15 Faithful to a promise or agreement. .²16 Agreed, engaged, contracted. .²17 Ready, being close or at hand. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Standing by itself (as a word). .²2 Stopping, standing still. .²3 Manner of standing. .²4 Perseverance on the right path.
